per_key_checks.assessment: Accessible name/tooltip of a named file or image actions-menu trigger (supplement-file-actions.tsx:181, image-actions-menu.tsx:365). The noun phrase is right: no imperative, so it does not read as a command to act on the name, which is what the context note forbids. {name} is byte-identical and undeclined; guillemets keep an arbitrary user string from needing a genitive and survive names containing punctuation. Meaning is exact. The one issue is the quoting divergence recorded as ru-1 (MINOR): the ru frame is unquoted in six existing values.

Default tooltip and unnamed-image trigger accessible name of the image overflow menu. Byte-identical to the existing ru ui.canvas.files.imageActions ("Действия с изображением") and to ui.canvas.finder_files_view.ui_canvas_files_imageactions, and the exact parallel of "Действия с файлом" for the file menu — so the generic and named variants of this menu now agree in one term. с + instrumental (с изображением) is correct Russian. Short noun phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation, as the context note asks.

aria-label of the role="slider" seek bar (sound-player.tsx:455, :506). Two things are correct here. (1) The term is the corpus's own: ru ui.chat.attachments.playback_position = "Позиция воспроизведения" for the English "Playback position" with role "slider name" — so the added воспроизведения is the settled Russian rendering of the concept, not invented wording, and it is what makes the label unambiguous between two clips on screen. (2) {label} is moved to the end behind a colon, which the context note explicitly permits ("Word order may change around {label}") and which is the only way to avoid demanding a genitive of an arbitrary user-supplied title; the same colon-before-label shape is used by ui.chat.tags.header_actions ("Действия с тегом: {name}") and ui.common.actions.date_time_picker.choose_date ("Выбрать дату: {label}"). No agreement with the inserted text, no numbers, no markup. The ru guide's "no typographic spacing before : ; ! ?" is met: U+0020 after the colon, none before it.
per_key_checks.context_note_reading: The note's "Translate only the surrounding word for position" is read as a guard against translating or normalising {label} and against adding a clause, not against using the locale's two-word term for playback position: the note's own first line says the control "names playback position".

context_metadata_check.current_note: Fallback for non-image data URIs with no usable name, including invalid percent encoding, whether or not a MIME type is present. Also used as synthetic upload metadata; valid names and attachment bytes stay unchanged. A 100px tile caption may truncate; maxCells is advisory, not measured fit.
context_metadata_check.previous_note: Fallback when the pasted data URI has no name or MIME type. A 100px tile caption may truncate; maxCells is advisory, not measured fit.
context_metadata_check.basis: Only `data:` paths that are not `data:image/` reach pasted_file, so 'non-image' is right (an image data URI without a usable name goes to pasted_image). Both the no-name= branch and the decodeURIComponent-throw branch return it, so 'including invalid percent encoding' and 'no usable name' are right; a decodable name= returns the real name verbatim. MIME presence is irrelevant for non-image data URIs, so 'whether or not a MIME type is present' is right — and the previous 'no name or MIME type' was the inaccurate half it replaces. attachment-encode.ts assigns getFileName() to the upload's `name` and stores stored.name ?? name, so 'synthetic upload metadata' is right; its comments state that valid decoded names stay verbatim and the original dataUrl/path is passed untouched, so 'valid names and attachment bytes stay unchanged' is right.
